definitions.explanation: Regular payments received after retirement, funded by contributions during working years.
Fixed payments received at regular intervals from an investment or insurance.

notes:
{年金|ねんきん} is a compound: ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ (year) + ⟦{金|きん}→金：02666_kin⟧ (money).

JAPANESE PENSION TYPES:
- ⟦{国民|こくみん}{年金|ねんきん}→国民年金：23534_kokuminnenkin⟧ (National Pension - basic, mandatory for all)
- ⟦{厚生|こうせい}→厚生：noentry⟧{年金|ねんきん} (Employees' Pension - for company employees)
- ⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧{年金|ねんきん} (Corporate pension)
- ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧{年金|ねんきん} (Personal/private pension)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年金|ねんきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ (to pay pension premiums)
- {年金|ねんきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧ (to receive pension)
- {年金|ねんきん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}する→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧ (to enroll in pension)
- {年金|ねんきん}⟦{受給|じゅきゅう}→受給：noentry⟧ (pension receipt)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's aging society has put pressure on the pension system. ⟦{年金問題|ねんきんもんだい}→年金問題：noentry⟧ (pension issues) is a frequent topic of discussion.
